title: ESP32-2432S028 CYD (Cheap Yellow Display)
summary: 320x240 screen, BOOT as the only button. A PDM microphone on the 4-pin header (clock GPIO 22, data GPIO 27) is driven, but the stock board has none fitted; no touchscreen, so otherwise text only. The SC8002B amplifier behind the speaker header plays three boot beeps through the chip's DAC. Experimental.
